evidence_kind: static original executable plus full raw-grid corpus scan

format.cell_255: all four downward rays accepted; cached support height usable
format.cell_0: at least one support query failed or hit rejection list; no cached support
format.height_source: fourth ray hit Y (not mean, bilinear sample or vertex height)
format.alternate_helper_difference: negative half ties differ from primary runtime; original linear-only bound/final-cell fallback not used by safe decoder

limitations: Support cache is not complete collision geometry or a proven walkability map.
Physical meter scale and scene-object-list category names are not recovered.
No interpolation: original stored Y is fourth accepted ray hit; scene triangles remain separate.
Primary runtime absent support uses a separate scene query; decoder returns None instead of inventing its result.

source_evidence.claim: Headerless byte and four-byte height buffers; selected filename uses zone-ID table.
Two signed loops [-1024,1023], x-fastest; consecutive byte and float stores.
Four downward scene queries; 255/all accepted or 0/any failed; stored height is fourth hit Y.
Float32 world-to-grid multiplier, center offset, pitch and ray constants read from executable memory.
Primary runtime rounds after float32 scale and +1024; bounds each axis; accepts byte255, reads Y float.
Signed nearest integer rounding with ties away from zero.
Separate helper rounds before centered offset; linear-only bounds and final-cell fallback are original quirks.
Direct byte helper also rounds before offset; 0x200400 = 1024*2048+1024.
First scene-object list hit rejects support; second list hit returns XYZ and normal.
Ray setter negates input direction; generator passes (0,1,0), producing (0,-1,0).
